title: Durable authorized injection Receipt, exact mount Readback, restart reconstruction, and rollback state

phases.objective: Persist an exact data-only authorized injection Receipt and verified mount Readback through a contract-local SQL registry with same-transaction readback, without storing runtime material or granting migration/provider/Production authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Canonical serialized injection Receipt and exact mount Readback produced by the authorized dependency-injection coordinator
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One exact durable state is inserted and read back with immutable digests while runtime material remains absent and exact replay is idempotent.
steps: Verify the contract-local schema-verification packet and exact schema digest.
Recompute the injection Receipt and mount Readback digests.
Prove Receipt/Readback parity across injection, bundle, snapshot, runtime, source, database, schema, and readback-cycle identities.
Acquire the advisory lock and row lock within one transaction.
Insert the data-only durable state and perform exact same-transaction readback.
Replay the identical registration without creating a second state.
assertions: Registry factory construction performs zero SQL connections.
Runtime object material is never persisted.
Conflicting or rehashed drifted evidence fails before mutation.
No route, server, migration, provider, deployment, main, or Production path is modified.

phases.objective: Promote and apply the durable injection-state schema only after separately governed live schema readiness, migration authorization, dry-run, Apply, and ledger/readback evidence.
blockers: The two injection-state tables remain contract-local and are not part of the governed runtime migration sequence.
No live schema verification for these tables exists.
No migration authorization, dry-run, Apply, ledger entry, or live readback exists.
No live server bootstrap consumes the durable registry.

phases.objective: Read the persisted Receipt/Readback after restart, reconstruct the canonical coordinator state without a second authorization consumption, and record rollback through row-version CAS plus immutable same-transaction readback.

e2e_journeys.actor: Restart reconciliation and rollback controller using the durable registry
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A second registry instance over the same synthetic SQL state
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Restart reconstruction preserves the exact mount Readback digest; rollback atomically marks the durable state inactive, writes one immutable receipt, restores fail-closed state, and rejects replay/reactivation.
steps: Read the exact persisted Receipt and mount Readback through a new registry instance.
Resume the canonical injection coordinator without consuming mount authorization again.
Require the rollback receipt to reference the exact active mount Readback.
Update the active state through row-version compare-and-swap.
Insert one immutable rollback receipt in the same transaction.
Read back both records before commit and reject second rollback or reactivation.
assertions: Restart reconstruction preserves the original mount Readback digest.
No runtime material is reconstructed from SQL without the canonical bundle.
Rollback uses exact active readback binding and row-version CAS.
Rolled-back state cannot be registered as active again.
Rollback replay is rejected and automatic retry remains disabled.

phases.objective: Observe one separately authorized non-production canary only after the schema is governed and the durable registry is bootstrapped through a fixed runtime composition.
This repository-only durable-state contract grants no migration Apply, provider, deployment, main, or Production authority.
